title: Solo Contributor Proposal - Content Moderator: ZOVERN [Postpaid]
body:
**Date: 4th May 2022**

**Role: Content Moderator**

**Contributor: ZOVERN**

**NSP: **Shankar Warang, Edgeware Agency

**Role overview:**
**	**The Content Moderator role majorly focuses on Content Creation, related research and Content restructuring/reforming.

**Need of the role:**
- Continuous need of the content in website designing, social media presence/marketing and PR.
- Feedback and restructuring of layouts across governance forum, EdgeApps and blog, etc. content related domains.


**Contributor’s first-person introduction:**
	“Hey, it’s me Zovern, '' I originally wandered into Edgeverse while looking for a crypto platform that I could hold long term and possibly build. Started the year in Discord reporting errors and joining the meetings. Finally understood the core values of self-governance and community strength and decided to become a contributor until it’s time to develop.” 

**Quick Background:**
10+ Year background in Information Technology. IT Manager (ITIL) responsible for Project Management, Inventory/Asset Management, Troubleshooting and Training. Current role in Business Intelligence providing Data Science Reporting via Power Bi.

**Voluntary contributions in the Edgeverse so far: (since 2/15/2022)**
- Edgeware & Kabocha - Visual Overview
- Edgeware & Kabocha: Project Overview [2021 - April 2022]
- EDG Visual Analysis - [Volume, Price, Correlation, Deviation, Market]
- Community Research: Document Page Hierarchy Refresh
- Procurement Fund for Infrastructure Assets
- Market Research: Crypto Storage Solutions
- Edgeware App - Governance Feature Expansion [Territories, Group Notifications]
- Market Research: Domain Services Partnership / Integration
- QA Report: Site Maintenance (Governance Forum, Delegation App, Polkadotjs/OnFinality, Discord)
- Community Research: Governance Updates Proposal [Website , App]
- Community Research/Findings: Forum, Website, EdgeApps suggestions' report


**Primary deliverables:**
- Constructive discussions
- Chain An
